bestBets.overview: Showers about both Saturday and Sunday at the 'Sunshine Coast'. The track highly likely to remain soft. Highlight of the day the 50K Noosa Cup.Well it was. More like the NOsir Cup now.  Kick things off with an 1800m Maiden Plate. No's 6,7,8 most likely supply the pace. Looks to be at least five in with a show - KOJAK, SHIP HAPPENS, FIVE OF US, HIGHLAND KITTY, and RANGERS PRIDE. I'm with the latter. Made up many lengths 2nd-up, can have the turn of hoof others can only wish for. And David Vandyke is fair-dinkum flying, 11 from 50 as I put pen to paper.

raceTips.comment:
Track rated a soft (5) for Sunday racing on the Sunshine Coast, showers are forecast however not until this evening.

First up we have an 1800m maiden where I'll lean to Highland Kitty who will strip even fitter third up this afternoon & gets to a suitable distance range, the drop in class is another positive. Keep Rangers Pride safe, lightly raced rises 400m, could be an out & out stayer & is in very good hands.

bestBets.overview: 1200m C4. No's 1,3,8 look to be the pace providers, some others do just that only when over more ground. ACAPULCO GIRL yet again got it done when resuming, keep in mind three of her opponents in that race bled. You do not see that too often, thankfully! She can pull out a run 2nd-up and the map looks suitable. TEN GOOD REASONS had three good excuses when resuming - slow out, held-up, poleaxed - hence can improve. MISSILE ONE maps a treat, 2nd-up some 18 months ago won this track and distance by more than six lengths. Was my pick, now staying home. TIZ WORTHY resuming new blood now with that man, David Vandyke. The booking of R Maloney reads like a free tip. Market watch on the resuming new blood TONKATSU GODDESS. And then there's CARBONARA. Slow out in what became a walk and never got a crack at them, snag is she's even-money to miss the start each and every time she goes to the office.

raceTips.comment: Taking a punt on the newcomer Tiz Worthy who is ex Lloyd Kennewell now with David Vandyke. Very interestingly resumes at 1200m which is not a distance she's had much exposure to, all her wins have been at 1000m, she is a strong finisher though. Market leads very important. Stablemate Acapulco Girl clearly the danger, Carbonara an improver on a dry track only.

bestBets.overview: 1300m Maiden. Note only sixteen can run and it's odds-on less than that will remain when final scratchings come through. #Tedious. #Isthereanybodyoutthere? Suffice to say the following for now. DARK MODE was easy in the betting when on debut and ran home like a horse still learning. Decent effort to secure a place, a wiser horse can go all the way in a field like this. LILI ANNA placed 2nd in a different heat that day, note was on better ground but won in slower time. WEE WINN freshened new blood, market watch. WELCOME ADVICE resuming new blood, trialing well enough for this, was my top pick, now out. WINNING HARLOW thereabouts both to date, B1st time here, was in the mix. FIERY LASS fitter again, she too is in the mix.

raceTips.comment: Dark Mode was kept safe in the market on debut at the Gold Coast when although green at times did find the line quite well. Race experience, an additional 100m & Ben Thompson to steer all suggests he could go a couple better. Lili Anna can keep improving whilst Fiery Lass should be primed third run back.

bestBets.overview: 1400m BM78 aka the Noosa Cup.  No's 1,3,5,8,13,14 did supply the pace in what was quite a line-up for this venue on this day of the week.  GRINZINGER CHAMP looked the one to beat, (was the Best for the Day) - of course it won very well yesterday.  LITTLE BEGINNINGS up from NSW, is going okay without winning, definitely had to be respected when all were 'chips in'. Now looks a great chance for Kris Lees to be rewarded for his professionalism.  CARRAVILLA was and remains the market watch, friendless when resuming, had no favours 2nd-up, here it is with a suitable map, could be this has been the target all along.

raceTips.comment: The 50K Noosa Cup is the day's highlight over 1400m. I'm with the locally trained Liberty Steps who clocked in third at the Gold Coast last start however there's little doubt he should have finished closer. Shuffled back before the turn, held up in the straight he closed well when finally in the clear. Little Beginnings brings solid form lines from down south & lands the rails gate. Carravilla in the mix also, should be peaking third-up.

bestBets.overview: 1400m 0-58. No's 1,6,11,13 looks to be where the pace resides in what looks an easy race to be winning. HOMERIC has a sense of timing, 3rd run in, could be fancied now and if so, can be winning. BADDA BOOM BABY landed good bets this track/trip two starts ago. Neither Columbo nor Poirot to name but two super-sleuths are yet to explain how or why, but win it did and the win was no fluke whatsoever. Since stepped up in distance and had no favours. IN GREAT SPIRIT invariably thereabouts, can and should be again. I SAY I SAY is B Thompson 1st time, early odds likely to be pounced upon.

raceTips.comment: Very difficult race to wind up the day. Homeric third run back from a break should be peaking, placed 3 of 4 at this distance range. Simba's Pride is only lightly raced & I doubt finds this any harder than Warwick last start, might be worth a small play at likely good odds. Clearly George a chance with a repeat of the latest run.
